boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten campus spaces for focused work, collaborative projects, recreation, practical support, and recharging between classes.

cards.title: Set Up for an After-Hours Work Session
cards.subtitle: A 24/7 study area and computer lab inside the Pfau Library Wedge
cards.notes: Bring your physical Coyote ID for secured evening, overnight, and Sunday entry, then use a lab station with your campus credentials.
cards.short_summary: The Cave gives students a round-the-clock indoor base for computer work and late study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB identifies The Cave in Pfau Library Wedge room PL-1109 as a 24-hour, seven-day study area with a self-service computer lab.
cards.source_title: Open Computer Labs | Information Technology Services | CSUSB
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Students use their Coyote ID and CSUSB password for computers; secured periods require a physical Coyote ID.

cards.entity_name: John M. Pfau Library Fifth Floor
cards.title: Move Upstairs When You Need Quiet
cards.subtitle: The library floor without group-seating areas
cards.notes: Take individual work to the fifth floor when the first floor feels busy; reserve an individual study room ahead if you need a door.
cards.short_summary: Pfau Library directs quiet-study seekers to its fifth floor because its layout avoids group seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pfau Library FAQ recommends the fifth floor for quiet study and explains that it tends to be quieter because it has no group-seating areas.
cards.source_title: Where is a quiet place to study? | Pfau Library FAQ
cards.access_notes: Use during current Pfau Library building hours; individual study rooms may be reserved separately.

cards.title: Give a Group Project Its Own Room
cards.subtitle: Reservable collaboration rooms on floors three through five
cards.notes: Reserve before your meeting, bring at least two people, and use the room's whiteboard without turning surrounding study areas into a discussion zone.
cards.short_summary: Enclosed Pfau rooms provide students with shared tables, power, and whiteboards for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Pfau Library documents reservable group study rooms on floors three through five, including rooms with whiteboards and electrical outlets.
cards.source_title: Group & Individual Study Rooms | John M. Pfau Library
cards.access_notes: Group rooms are for groups of at least two. Most may be reserved in advance; building access follows current library hours.

cards.title: Turn a Class Idea Into a Prototype
cards.subtitle: A library workspace for 3D printing and hands-on creation
cards.notes: Bring a project concept to the first-floor lab and ask staff which creation tools fit it; plan extra time for equipment guidance and production.
cards.short_summary: The Innovation Lab adds fabrication and experimentation tools to an otherwise conventional library work session.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB states that Pfau Library's Innovation Lab and Innovation Studio provide 3D printing, podcasting, and video-editing tools that students can use for free.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Pfau Library complex; verify current lab availability and equipment procedures before a time-sensitive project.

cards.title: Reset Between Classes Without Leaving Campus
cards.subtitle: A wellness lounge with study, hammock, nap, and massage-chair spaces
cards.notes: Register at the front desk, bring your student ID or Recreation and Wellness app, and reserve specialty seating when the service requires it.
cards.short_summary: The Retreat combines quiet work areas with bookable spaces intended for short restorative breaks.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB documents study space, hammocks, massage chairs, and napping space at The Retreat and says current students, faculty, and staff may use its services free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Located in SMSU South 102A. Registration and student ID or the Recreation and Wellness app are required; summer eligibility differs for students not enrolled in summer courses.

cards.title: Use a Gaming Station Between Commitments
cards.subtitle: Student gaming space in SMSU South room 117
cards.notes: Check in during posted hours for a PC or Switch session, and confirm event closures before organizing a group visit around a specific game.
cards.short_summary: The arena offers campus gamers dedicated equipment for casual sessions, connection, and organized competition.
cards.evidence_claim: The Santos Manuel Student Union says the Esports Arena has 18 gaming PCs and two Nintendo Switch consoles that all CSUSB students may use for free.
cards.source_title: Esports Arena | Santos Manuel Student Union | CSUSB
cards.access_notes: Located in SMSU South 117. Student use is free; guests must be accompanied by a student. Consult the page for current semester hours.

cards.title: Fit a Bowling Game Into a Class Break
cards.subtitle: An eight-lane bowling alley with four pool tables in SMSU North
cards.notes: Bring your physical Coyote ID, ask about the daily student game, and contact the facility in advance if your group wants a reservation.
cards.short_summary: Coyote Lanes gives students an indoor place for a quick game or a planned group activity on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB describes Coyote Lanes as an eight-lane bowling alley with four pool tables and offers one free game per day to current CSUSB students.
cards.source_title: Coyote Lanes | Santos Manuel Student Union | CSUSB
cards.access_notes: Walk-ins are first-come, first-served. Current students need a physical Coyote ID for the daily free game; shoe or sock rental and additional play may cost extra.

cards.title: Give Graduate Work a Dedicated Home Base
cards.subtitle: A graduate-only lounge, computer lab, and group-study hub
cards.notes: Use the computer lab for focused work, reserve the group space for collaboration, or bring a meal to the kitchen between graduate commitments.
cards.short_summary: The GSSC concentrates practical work amenities and informal gathering space for CSUSB graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB says the Graduate Student Success Center in SMSU South 202 has a computer lab, reservable group-study space, a coffee bar, kitchen appliances, and a lounge.
cards.source_title: Graduate Student Success Center | Santos Manuel Student Union | CSUSB
cards.access_notes: Located in SMSU South 202 and designed for graduate students. Check the official page for current operating hours and meeting-space booking.

cards.title: Check Into a Smaller Graduate Study Room
cards.subtitle: A quiet workspace behind Graduate Studies in CE 356A
cards.notes: Check in at Graduate Studies before settling at the group table or desktop, and bring your own snack if you plan to use the microwave.
cards.short_summary: This compact graduate space supports quiet work with seating, a desktop computer, scanner, and microwave.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB identifies the Graduate Student Outreach Center in College of Education room 356A as a graduate study and relaxation space with seating, a desktop, scanner, and microwave.
cards.source_title: Graduate Student Outreach Center | Graduate Studies | CSUSB
cards.access_notes: Graduate students must check in at the Office of Graduate Studies in CE 356 or with the designated staff contact before using the space.

cards.title: Build Movement Into the Campus Day
cards.subtitle: The student fitness and recreation facility on the east side of campus
cards.notes: Bring your student identification, check the current activity schedule, and choose equipment or a program that fits the time between classes.
cards.short_summary: The Recreation and Wellness Center gives enrolled students a shared campus setting for exercise and active breaks.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB describes the Student Recreation and Wellness Center as a student facility for staying active and connected and states that enrolled students' membership is included in tuition.
cards.source_title: Student Recreation & Wellness Center | Join the Pack | CSUSB
cards.access_notes: Access is included for students enrolled in classes. Verify current facility hours, identification requirements, and eligibility during summer or enrollment gaps.
